name: Certified Information Systems Security Professional

fee.note: U.S. list price for the Americas, Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Africa; EMEA pays EUR 719.04 and the UK GBP 606.69. Taxes depend on the exam location.

exam.format: Computerized adaptive test (CAT) in all five languages (English, Chinese, German, Japanese, Spanish): 100–150 multiple choice and advanced items in 3 hours at ISC2-authorized Pearson VUE centers. Chinese only in set windows.

scope: Designing, engineering and managing an organization's security program: security and risk management, asset security, architecture and engineering, network security, identity and access management, assessment and testing, security operations and software development security.
requirements: To be certified: five years of cumulative full-time experience in two or more of the eight CISSP domains; a relevant degree or a credential on ISC2's approved list can satisfy one year, and part-time work and internships count. Without the experience, passing makes you an Associate of ISC2 with six years to earn it. Within nine months of passing, an ISC2-certified member (or ISC2, with proof of employment) must endorse the application.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: A new CISSP outline takes effect April 15, 2027. Domain 1 becomes Security Governance and Risk Management, AI ethics is added, and the weights change to 13.6, 12, 12.8, 12.8, 13.6, 11.2, 12.8 and 11.2% for domains 1–8; length and item range stay the same. Exams before that date follow the April 15, 2024 outline used here.

Prices and taxes follow the exam location: ISC2 lists U.S. dollars for most regions, euros for EMEA and pounds for the UK. Pearson VUE charges U.S. $50 to reschedule and U.S. $100 to cancel. Confirm at checkout.
An exam-only purchase is one attempt that must be taken within 365 days. ISC2 also sells Peace of Mind Protection (two attempts within 180 days); its price is not on the pricing page.
Staying certified: U.S. $135 a year and 120 CPE credits per three-year cycle (40 a year suggested). Associates of ISC2 pay U.S. $50 a year and earn 15 CPE credits a year.

prep.title: CISSP Certification Exam Outline
prep.note: The April 2024 outline and the one effective April 15, 2027, as PDF in five languages.

domains_note: Weights from the ISC2 CISSP Certification Exam Outline effective April 15, 2024, read 2026-11-17. The outline effective April 15, 2027 changes them (see caveats).
